prompt: Identical row houses for the workers.

card.name: Workers' Row

site.text: Level ground with a straight street lined by terraced rows of houses

style.text: Plain, uniform, utilitarian: identical repeated facades, simple materials

purpose.text: Housing for workers: identical row houses

card.interpretation: You asked for identical row houses for workers. I took the site as flat ground with a straight street, the style as plain and uniform, and the purpose as worker housing. The program is eight identical houses plus a small shared well so the row has a heart.
assumptions: Size S, since only a single row of housing was described
Density high because row houses are tightly packed
Added one communal well as the only non-house building
No story given, so none invented
Style left as a custom plain look, with no template

program.notes: Identical terraced houses sharing the same plan, facade and roof, lined up along one street.
Shared well and small square at the end of the street.
